-- message --
billing: compute invoice totals in whole cents
-- base/internal/billing/invoice.go --
package billing

import "math"

// Total returns the invoice total in cents, rounding each line.
func Total(lines []float64, taxRate float64) int64 {
	var sum float64
	for _, l := range lines {
		sum += l
	}
	return int64(math.Round(sum * (1 + taxRate)))
}
-- head/internal/billing/invoice.go --
package billing

// Total returns the invoice total in cents, rounding each line.
func Total(lines []float64, taxRate float64) int64 {
	var sum int64
	for _, l := range lines {
		sum += int64(l)
	}
	return sum + int64(float64(sum)*taxRate)
}
